item.title: House Ethics Probes Rep. Gomez Over Misconduct Allegations
item.description: The committee is investigating claims of inappropriate sexual contact with a staffer.

item.title: Actress Hayden Panettiere passes away at 36 after cardiac arrest
item.description: Her representative confirmed the news to ABC News on Sunday. The cause of death for the "Nashville" star has not yet been determined.

item.title: Watch Live: Prosecution rests in Lindsay Clancy trial, defense begins
item.description: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy resumes Monday in Plymouth Superior Court, entering its fourth week of witness testimony.

item.title: Study: Strong teen-dog bonds may reduce anxiety
item.description: Research involving over 500 teenagers found that close relationships with pet dogs were linked to lower stress and anxiety levels.
